expo.name: LifePilot

infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: LifePilot uses your camera to scan receipts on-device. Nothing is uploaded.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: LifePilot reads photos to scan receipts. Everything runs on-device — nothing is uploaded.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: LifePilot may save captured receipts to your photo library.

plugins.cameraPermissionText: LifePilot uses your camera to scan receipts on-device. Nothing is uploaded.

plugins.iosMicrophonePermission: LifePilot uses your microphone to let you speak a task instead of typing it. Transcription runs on-device — nothing is uploaded.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: LifePilot uses your approximate location only to fetch local weather for a more accurate hydration target. It's grid-rounded, sent to no one but the weather service, and never stored off-device.

expo._comment_privacy: No network/analytics plugins. Inference is fully on-device (see docs/overwhelm-model-contract.md). react-native-executorch is autolinked native code; this app CANNOT run in Expo Go — it needs a dev client / prebuild.
